# 7432 - Quadruple 2-input OR gate

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7432.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7432.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 10 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![7432 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7432.png) | ![7432 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/or2.png) | ![7432 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/or2.png) |

One rectangle split down the middle: X in the left half, triangle in the right half.

How to tell it on a drawing: Split box, X left, triangle right = OR (NOR followed by an inverter).

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 1Y = 1A OR 1B | 1Y is the OR of 1A, 1B. |
| 6 | 2Y = 2A OR 2B | 2Y is the OR of 2A, 2B. |
| 8 | 3Y = 3A OR 3B | 3Y is the OR of 3A, 3B. |
| 11 | 4Y = 4A OR 4B | 4Y is the OR of 4A, 4B. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.8 |
| inputSchmitt | no |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 400 ohm, CL 15 pF.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| any | Y | PLH | 10 | 15 |
| any | Y | PHL | 14 | 22 |

## Notes

The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delay; minNs is null (the path-delay function uses 0 ns). No setup/hold/pulse-width limits apply to a gate, so timingLimits is empty.

## Sources

- [TI SN5432/SN7432/SN74LS32/SN74S32 datasheet SDLS100](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn7432.pdf) - 1, 3; SN7432
